nodes.label: dependency-cruiser Graph Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Authoritative CI verification of resolved import graphs across TypeScript files to prevent boundary escapes and circular dependencies.

nodes.label: Five-Layer API Module Standard
nodes.rationale: Each module contains: <module>.public.ts, <module>.container.ts, domain/, application/, and infrastructure/ & interface/.

nodes.label: End-to-End Request Flow Pattern
nodes.rationale: Client -> Middleware -> Router -> Controller -> UseCase -> Ports -> Adapters -> Response formatting.

nodes.label: Monorepo Topology and Apps vs Packages
nodes.norm_label: monorepo topology and apps vs packages
nodes.rationale: apps/ produce deployables and never depend on other apps; packages/ are build-time shared source packages.

nodes.label: SMS/WhatsApp Gateway Selection Question
nodes.rationale: Authentication uses Phone + OTP; production requires WhatsApp-first delivery with SMS fallback.

nodes.label: Object Storage for Media & KYC Selection Question
nodes.norm_label: object storage for media & kyc selection question
nodes.rationale: Driver licenses, identity proofs, and vehicle images require secure blob storage abstracted behind infrastructure ports.

nodes.label: Distance Matrix & Routing Service Question
nodes.rationale: Long-distance and outstation band pricing requires accurate route distance computation; mocked locally with config switch.

nodes.label: Workspace Verification Workflow
nodes.rationale: Running typecheck, lint:deps, test, and build across the monorepo.

nodes.label: Development Workflow Commands
nodes.rationale: Commands for dev:api, dev:worker, dev:web, and dev:full against local docker-compose infrastructure.

nodes.label: pnpm Dependency Overrides
nodes.rationale: Pinned dependency versions for React 19.2.3, react-dom 19.2.3, and uuid 14.0.2.

nodes.label: Monorepo Architecture & Stack Initialization Decision
nodes.rationale: Adopted pnpm workspaces v11 with Turborepo, hoisted nodeLinker, raw TypeScript zero-build shared packages, 5-layer Clean Architecture API with dependency-cruiser DAG validation, single-node Mongo 7 replica set rs0 + Redis 7 BullMQ, Next.js App Router admin.

nodes.label: Machine-Enforced Architectural Rules
nodes.rationale: Rules include not-to-unresolvable, no-circular, module-internals-are-private, domain-imports-nothing-above-it, application-depends-on-ports-not-adapters, interface-depends-on-ports-not-adapters, shared-is-below-modules.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Dependency Rule
nodes.rationale: Every dependency arrow points inward toward domain/. Domain imports nothing above it. Infrastructure implements interfaces declared in Domain.

nodes.label: SOLID Principles in Practice
nodes.rationale: SRP across module components, OCP via new adapters for domain ports, LSP via lightweight unit test fakes, ISP with focused port boundaries, DIP where use cases and adapters depend on domain abstractions.

nodes.label: Zero-Build Shared Package Strategy
nodes.rationale: Shared packages export raw TypeScript source directly, compiled by consuming applications to eliminate out-of-sync builds.

nodes.label: Core Engineering Tenets
nodes.rationale: 1. Modules talk through .public.ts only. 2. Ports in Domain, Adapters in Infrastructure. 3. Zero-build shared packages. 4. Machine-enforced invariants via dependency-cruiser.

nodes.label: Node.js 22 ESM + Express
nodes.rationale: Fast lightweight HTTP API server with native ESM and esbuild bundling.

nodes.label: MongoDB 7 Replica Set rs0
nodes.rationale: Document database running single-node replica set rs0 to enable multi-document ACID transactions.

nodes.label: Next.js 15 + React 19 Admin Frontend
nodes.rationale: Admin panel with React Server Components, standalone Docker build output, and transpilePackages support.

nodes.label: pnpm & Turborepo Selection
nodes.rationale: Fast deterministic package management with nodeLinker: hoisted, paired with Turborepo task caching and parallel execution.

nodes.label: Redis 7 + BullMQ
nodes.rationale: Distributed background job queueing and rate limiting with durable retryable job processing.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS Styling
nodes.rationale: Utility-first styling with zero runtime overhead and predictable responsive layouts.

nodes.label: TypeScript Static Typing Configuration
nodes.rationale: Strict mode, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, and verbatimModuleSyntax for shared contracts.

nodes.label: Architectural Enforcement Convention
nodes.rationale: Strict domain-driven boundaries validated at build time with dependency-cruiser.

nodes.label: Money Representation Convention
nodes.rationale: Always stored and transmitted as integer paise (1 INR = 100 paise); floating-point values strictly disallowed.

nodes.label: Timestamp Representation Convention
nodes.rationale: All timestamps stored in databases or sent across wire contracts must be UTC ISO-8601 strings or epoch integers.

nodes.label: UUIDv7 Identifier Convention
nodes.rationale: Time-ordered UUIDv7 identifiers with prefixed entity namespaces for records where creation order matters.

nodes.label: pnpm Hoisted Node Linker Configuration
nodes.rationale: nodeLinker: hoisted configured to ensure seamless bundler and module resolution across Next.js and esbuild.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Rules
nodes.rationale: Consult graphify-out/ for architecture and codebase questions; query via CLI or MCP and update graph on modifications.
